basic_details.short_information: Guru Govind Singh Govt Hospital (GGSGH) has announced 5 vacancies for the Consultant post on a contract basis. Interested candidates can apply offline by submitting their applications in person or by post in a sealed envelope to The Medical Superintendent, First floor, Block-B, Guru Govind Singh Hospital, Government of NCT of Delhi on or before 21 October 2026. Applicants must be retired Government officials from the posts of Senior Assistant, Assistant Section Officer, or up to Section Officer with relevant experience. The remuneration is regulated as per prevailing instructions and orders of

Experience: Experience in establishment, administration, accounts, office procedure, file processing, drafting, record management, etc. Service Record: Applicant should have a clean service record and vigilance status report.

important_instructions: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual in nature initially for six months or till regular incumbents join through DSSSB / Health & Family Welfare, whichever is earlier. Selected retired officials shall not have any claim for regular appointment or continuation. Maximum age limit and other eligibility conditions are as per Government instructions issued from time to time. The competent authority reserves the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason. The number of posts may increase or decrease as per administrative requirements. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date shall not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The completed application form must be submitted in a sealed envelope to the following postal address: The Medical Superintendent, First floor, Block-B, Guru Govind Singh Hospital, Government of NCT of Delhi, Raghubeer Nagar, New Delhi - 110027

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility: Retired Government officials from the posts of Senior Assistant / Assistant Section Officer, up to Section Officer. Experience: Experience in establishment, administration, accounts, office procedure, file processing, drafting, record management, etc. Service Record: Applicant should have a clean service record and vigilance status report.

rows.pay: Regulated as per prevailing Finance Department instructions/orders for retired government servants

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copy of PPO Self-attested copy of Aadhaar Card Self-attested copy of PAN Card Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Copy of retirement order Last Pay Certificate / Last Pay Slip Experience certificates, if any Vigilance Clearance / Integrity Certificate, if available Recent passport size photographs Any other relevant document

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of scrutiny of applications, verification of documents, preparation of a list of suitable candidates, and an interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual in nature initially for six months or till regular incumbents join through DSSSB / Health & Family Welfare, whichever is earlier. Selected retired officials shall not have any claim for regular appointment or continuation. Maximum age limit and other eligibility conditions are as per Government instructions issued from time to time. The competent authority reserves the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason. The number of posts may increase or decrease as per administrative requirements. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for the GGSGH Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies available for the Consultant post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of applications is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for the GGSGH Consultant post?
faq.answer: Retired Government officials who held the posts of Senior Assistant, Assistant Section Officer, or up to Section Officer with experience in establishment, administration, accounts, and office procedures are eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the nature of engagement and duration?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely contractual and temporary, initially for a period of six months or till regular incumbents join through DSSSB / Health & Family Welfare, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q5. How is the remuneration determined for these consultants?
faq.answer: The remuneration is regulated as per the prevailing instructions and orders of the Finance Department, GNCTD applicable to retired Government servants engaged as consultants.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of required documents in a sealed envelope to the office of the Medical Superintendent at Guru Govind Singh Hospital.

faq.question: Q7. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The date of the interview is scheduled for 23 October 2026, following the publication of the list of suitable candidates on 22 October 2026.
